reply_paused: Paused until {date}. Send 'resume' or just wait.
reply_limit_max: More often than {freq} is not possible.
reply_limit_min: Less often than {freq} is not possible.
welcome: You are subscribed. You will get {freq} between {start} and {end}.
ui_none: No recipients yet. Add one below.
ui_step1: Install the free ntfy app (App Store, Google Play or F-Droid).
ui_android: Android: scan this QR code with the camera. The ntfy app opens and subscribes right away.
ui_iphone: iPhone (or by hand): tap + in the ntfy app and enter this.
ui_step3: Done. Every photo comes with buttons to change the rhythm.
ui_ios_note: Is the server not ntfy.sh? Then first turn on 'Use another server' and enter the server.
ui_empty: No photos found in the folder.
app_ios_step1: Tap the Share button: the square with the arrow pointing up, at the bottom of the screen (on an iPad at the top).
app_empty: Your first memory is on its way.
app_privacy: No account, no ads, no tracking. Photos come without location data and are only loaded from the sender's own server.
js_ios_install_first: On an iPhone, notifications work once Back in Frame is on your home screen:
js_push_unsupported: This browser cannot show notifications. You can still look at your memories here.
js_push_denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in your settings for this site, then reload.
js_push_on: Notifications are on for this device.
js_push_off: Notifications are off. Turn them on to get a memory now and then.
js_push_failed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
js_command_failed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
ui_app_link: Send this link to the recipient. They open it, and on an iPhone add it to the home screen first. Anyone with the link sees the photos: share it only with them.
ui_app_off: The web app is off. Set BACKINFRAME_APP_URL to use it.
reply_hint: Reply more, less or pause to change how often.
mail_footer: You get this because someone added you to Back in Frame. Do you want to stop? Ask them to remove you. Replies to this e-mail are not read.
chat_id: Hello! Your chat ID is {id}. Give it to the person who sends you memories.
ui_address_note: Only for e-mail, Telegram, Signal, Matrix and Discord: the e-mail address, chat ID, phone number, room ID or webhook URL.
ui_help_email: Photos arrive as an e-mail with the photo in it. The recipient needs nothing else.
ui_help_telegram: Ask the recipient to open {bot} in Telegram and tap Start. The bot answers with their chat ID: enter it as the address.
ui_help_signal: Photos come from the Signal number {number}. Enter the recipient's phone number with country code, like +31612345678.
ui_help_matrix: Invite {user} to a room with the recipient and enter the room ID (room settings → Advanced; it starts with !).
ui_help_discord: In Discord: channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New webhook → Copy webhook URL. Anyone in that channel sees the photos.
ui_has_buttons: Every photo comes with buttons to change the rhythm.
ui_has_replies: The recipient can reply more, less or pause to change the rhythm.
ui_no_buttons: This channel has no buttons: change the rhythm here.
ui_channel_off: {channel} is not set up on this server any more. Choose another delivery below, or see the admin guide.
welcome_buttons: You are subscribed. You will get {freq} between {start} and {end}. Use the buttons below each photo to change the rhythm.
welcome_replies: You are subscribed. You will get {freq} between {start} and {end}. Reply more, less or pause to change the rhythm.
ui_sync_started: Sync started. Refresh this page in a minute.
app_ios_title: Put Back in Frame on your home screen
app_ios26_step1: Tap the ••• button next to the address bar at the bottom. (If you see the Share button, tap that and skip the next step.)
app_ios_step_add: Scroll down a little and tap “{add}”.
app_ios_step_open: Open Back in Frame from your home screen and tap “{button}” there.
app_ios_browser_step1: Tap the Share button. In Chrome it is in the address bar, in Firefox under the ••• menu.
app_ios_inapp: You opened this link inside another app. Open it in Safari first: tap ••• or the compass and choose “Open in Safari”. Or copy the link and paste it in Safari.
app_ios_old: Your iPhone needs iOS 16.4 or newer for notifications. You can update it in Settings → General → Software Update. Until then you can look at your memories here.
app_ios_missing: Don't see “{add}”? Open this page in Safari first; the button below copies its link.
app_link_copied: Link copied. Paste it in Safari.
app_guide_picture: Animation of the steps on an iPhone
ui_twofa_off_text: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app (such as Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator or 1Password) on top of your password. Optional.
ui_twofa_setup_step1: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or type in the key.
ui_twofa_qr_label: QR code for your authenticator app
ui_twofa_setup_step2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
ui_twofa_codes_text: If you lose your phone, you can log in with one of these codes. Each code works once. Store them somewhere safe, for example in your password manager: you will not see them again.
ui_twofa_disable_text: To turn it off, enter your password and a code from the app or a recovery code.
ui_twofa_login_text: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Back in Frame. Lost your phone? Enter one of your recovery codes.
ui_err_twofa_code: That code is not right. Try the newest code from the app.
ui_err_twofa_expired: That took too long. Log in again.
ui_err_too_many_tries: Too many failed attempts. Try again in fifteen minutes.
ui_security_no_password: The admin page has no password, so there is no login and no two-step verification. Set BACKINFRAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD (see the admin guide), or put the page behind a login of your own.
ui_sessions_text: Logged in somewhere you no longer use? This ends every session except this one.
ui_err_twofa_disable: Password or code is not right; two-step verification is still on.
ui_twofa_reset_hint: Lost both? On the server, run: docker exec backinframe backinframe reset-2fa
ui_hearts_no_app: Hearts can only be given in the Back in Frame web app. No recipient uses it yet.
ui_hearts_summary: Hearts: {hearted} of {sent} memories sent in the web app ({rate}%).
ui_hearts_explain: Recipients can tap a heart on a photo in the web app. A photo with a heart comes back to that person a bit more often. Recipients are told that you can see their hearts.
ui_hearts_unloved_explain: Photos that went out three times or more in the web app without a heart. Perhaps they can go from the folder.
ui_hearts_unloved_none: None: every photo sent often has a heart.
ui_review_explain: In the first two weeks of January, the first send moment brings each recipient their year in memories instead of a single photo: in the web app a page with twelve photos, elsewhere one collage. Only for recipients who got at least {min} memories that year.
ui_review_too_little: Too few memories that year for a review.
ui_review_opted_out: Year review is off for this recipient.
ui_year_review_on: Send a year review in January
app_hearts_note: Tap ♥ on a photo you love: it comes back a little more often. The person who sends you these memories can see which photos have a heart.
review_text: Memories this year: {n}. Most of them from {album}.
ui_photos_intro: The caption of a photo comes from its album and the date in the file. Here you can change it per photo: a title of its own, another date, or a short note.
ui_photo_date_hint: From the photo itself. Change it if it is wrong; "this day, years ago" uses this date.
ui_photo_date_changed: Changed by you. The photo itself says: {date}.
ui_photo_date_reset: Use the date from the photo again
ui_photo_note_hint: Optional, one short line under the date, for example who is in it or where it was.
ui_err_photo_date: That date is not valid. Use a date in the past.
ui_photo_saved_hint: Applies from now on, also in the web app galleries. Notifications already sent do not change.
ui_album_sender_hint: Shown as "from …" with every photo in this album, also new ones. Empty: nothing is shown.
ui_photo_sender_hint: Who this photo is from, for example "Anna". Empty: nothing is shown.
ui_photo_delete_hint: It came in through an upload link, so it can be removed here. Photos from your own folder you remove in that folder.
ui_uploads_intro: With an upload link someone can add photos to one album without an account: a brother, a sister, a friend. They cannot see or delete anything. Their name is shown as "from …" with their photos.
ui_uploads_need_app: Upload links work through the web app port. Set BACKINFRAME_APP_URL first (admin guide, §4).
ui_uploads_album_hint: An existing album name or a new one, for example "Grandchildren".
ui_uploads_made: Link made. Send it to the person.
ui_uploads_revoke_confirm: Stop this link? Photos already sent in stay.
upload_intro: Hello {name}. Photos and videos you add here go into the album {album} and come back now and then as a memory. You can only add here; you cannot see or delete anything.
upload_limits: Up to {n} at a time, at most {mb} MB per file.
upload_privacy: The photos stay on the server of the person who sent you this link. Location and other details are removed before a photo is sent as a memory.
upload_too_often: Too many uploads in a short time. Try again in an hour.
ui_admins_intro: Everyone here can do everything on this admin page, also add or remove other admins.
ui_admins_no_password: Set BACKINFRAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD first. Without it, everyone who can reach this page is an admin.
ui_admin_main_hint: logs in with the server password, without a name
ui_admin_name_hint: Leave empty if you log in with the server password.
ui_admin_invite_hint: They get a link to choose their own password. The link works for 7 days and once.
ui_admin_invite_send: Send this link yourself, for example in a chat. It is shown only now. It only works where this admin page can be reached.
ui_admin_invite_text: Choose a password for this admin page, at least {n} characters. You log in with your name and this password.
ui_admin_invite_gone: It was used, it is older than 7 days, or it was withdrawn. Ask for a new one.
ui_admin_welcome: Welcome, {name}. You are now an admin.
ui_admin_password_changed: Password changed. Your other sessions have ended.
ui_err_admin_password: The password needs at least {n} characters.
ui_err_admin_mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
ui_err_admin_exists: There is already an admin with that name.
